question: Who among the following was the son of Ustad Allauddin Khan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ali Akbar Khan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ali Akbar Khan was the son of Ustad Allauddin Khan: 
 
• Ali Akbar Khan was a Hindustani classical musician who played the sarod.
 
• He was a member of the Maihar gharana and was known for his virtuosity.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 1967 and the Padma Vibhushan in 1989.
 
• He was also the first Indian musician to receive a MacArthur Fellowship in 1991. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ustad Allauddin Khan was also a musician who formed an orchestra troupe called the "Maihar String Band". He was honored with the title of "Khan Saheb" by the British Government. He received the Sangeet Natak Academy Award in 1952, the Padmabhushan in 1958, and the Padmabibhushan in 1971. 
 
• Other descendants of Ustad Allauddin Khan who became musicians include his daughter Annapurna Devi, nephew Raja Hossain Khan, and grandson Aashish Khan.
